verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same flaws. The skates were scaled up so much that the laces barely show and the top skate is cut off at the top edge. The skate blade comes right down onto the 'ICE' headline. The edge-cropped circles were moved inside the canvas, where they read as broken arcs floating mid-layout. The text block, code row and CTA are stuck in a narrow central column with wide empty side margins, so the design looks like a shrunk copy rather than a layout rearranged for the new shape.
